Review of allocate_cents (approve): Reviewed allocate_cents. Logic is correct: floor-div base allocation, then distribute leftover cents by largest remainder, earlier line wins ties. Unit tests (examples) and acceptance tests (largest_remainder, refund_total, invalid_weights) all pass. One note: the sign-dependent tie-break (later index wins for negative totals) is not required by the spec, which says 'on equal remainders the earlier line wins' unconditionally - the refund_total test passes either way because the remainders are equal. Consider simplifying to a single sort key (-remainder, index) to match the spec exactly. Approving as-is; no blocking issues.

Reviewed LEDGERLIB-104 - approved. Logic is solid and all unit+acceptance tests pass. One non-blocking note: the sign-dependent tie-break isn't required by the spec (earlier line wins unconditionally); the refund test passes either way. Consider simplifying to a single sort key. Good work!
